question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1 \\ -2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-1\end{aligned}\,\,[\begin{aligned}5 & -10 & 5 \\ -10 & a & b \\ 5 & -10 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ c \\ 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the system of linear equations and its corresponding normal equation shown above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we write our system in matrix form as $Ax=b,$ where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 \\ -2 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

The normal equation corresponding to $Ax=b$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{T}\,Ax & ={A}^{T}b \\ [\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ -2 & 4 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 \\ -2 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ -2 & 4 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}5 & -10 & 5 \\ -10 & 20 & -10 \\ 5 & -10 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -6 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=20+(-10)+(-6)=4.
$$
